name: Galeb Duhr Rockcaller
tactics: Like the earthbreaker, the rockcaller disguises itself as a boulder until it attacks. It uses rocky terrain each turn to limit its enemies’ ability to shift or escape. At the same time, it uses earthen grasp to restrain a foe or rolling attack to knock an enemy prone. It continues to fight until bloodied, at which point it tries to escape by burrowing into the earth.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

sourceBooks: P1 King of the Trollhaunt Warrens
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Rolling Attack
powers.range: The galeb duhr rockcaller moves up to 4 squares and then attacks an adjacent target

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: The galeb duhr rockcaller moves up to 4 squares and then attacks an adjacent target

hit.description: damage, and the target is pushed 1 square and knocked prone

powers.name: Earthen Grasp
powers.flavorText: An earthen fist rises up to restrain the target

hit.description: the target is restrained (save ends). The target must be in direct contact with the ground or the attack fails. The rockcaller can use earthen grasp only against one creature at a time

effect.description: up to 4 squares within range become difficult terrain. The squares need not be contiguous, but the affected terrain must consist of earth or stone
